arxiv-2103-04592.title: Implicit Linear Algebra and Basic Circuit Theory II: port behaviour of rigid multiports Journal: Linear Algebra and its Applications
arxiv-2103-04592.creator: H. Narayanan
arxiv-2103-04592.description: Abstract In this paper, we define the notion of rigidity for linear electrical multiports and for matroid pairs. We show the parallel between the two and study the consequences of this parallel. We present applications to testing, using purely matroidal methods, whether a connection of rigid multiports yields a linear network with unique solution.

arxiv-2111-06573.title: Bounds for Treatment Effects in the Presence of Anticipatory Behavior
arxiv-2111-06573.creator: Aibo Gong
arxiv-2111-06573.description: Abstract In program evaluations, units can often anticipate the implementation of a new policy before it occurs. Such anticipatory behavior can lead to units’ outcomes becoming dependent on their future treatment assignments. In this paper, I employ a potential-outcomes framework to analyze the treatment effect with anticipation.

arxiv-2111-11902.title: GEVD-based Low-Rank Channel Covariance Matrix Estimation and MMSE Channel Estimation for Uplink Cellular Massive MIMO Systems
arxiv-2111-11902.creator: Robbe Van Rompaey, Marc Moonen
arxiv-2111-11902.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Robbe Van Rompaey, Marc Moonen. Uplink channel estimation is a crucial component for the performance of cellular massive MIMO systems. However, when the number of user equipments (UEs) grows, the sharing of the available resources causes interference between UEs in neighboring cells. Minimum mean squared error (MMSE) channel estimators have been proposed to mitigate this interference, but these require estimates of the channel covariance matrices.

arxiv-2205-08508.title: A CLIP-Hitchhiker’s Guide to Long Video Retrieval
arxiv-2205-08508.creator: Max Bain 1, Arsha Nagrani 1, Gül Varol 2, Andrew Zisserman 1
arxiv-2205-08508.description: Abstract Our goal in this paper is the adaptation of image-text models for long video retrieval. Recent works have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance in video retrieval by adopting CLIP, effectively hitchhiking on the image-text representation for video tasks. However, there has been limited success in learning temporal aggregation that outperform mean-pooling the image-level representations extracted per frame by CLIP.

arxiv-2209-12820.title: Relative homotopy approach to topological phases in quantum walks
arxiv-2209-12820.creator: Andrzej Grudka, Marcin Karczewski, Paweł Kurzyński, Jan Wójcik, Antoni Wójcik
arxiv-2209-12820.description: Abstract Discrete-time quantum walks (DTQWs) provide a convenient platform for a realisation of many topological phases in noninteracting systems. They often offer more possibilities than systems with a static Hamiltonian. Nevertheless, researchers are still looking for DTQW symmetries protecting topological phases and for definitions of appropriate topological invariants.

arxiv-2210-00058.title: Hardware Trojan Threats to Cache Coherence in Modern 2.5D Chiplet Systems
arxiv-2210-00058.creator: Gino A. Chacon, Charles Williams, Johann Knechtel, Ozgur Sinanoglu, Paul V. Gratz
arxiv-2210-00058.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gino A. Chacon, Charles Williams, Johann Knechtel, Ozgur Sinanoglu, Paul V. Gratz. As industry moves toward chiplet-based designs, the insertion of hardware Trojans poses a significant threat to the security of these systems. These systems rely heavily on cache coherence for coherent data communication, making coherence an attractive target.

arxiv-2212-11335.title: Instantaneous physics-based ground motion maps using reduced-order modeling
arxiv-2212-11335.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . Physics-based simulations of earthquake ground motion are useful to complement recorded ground motions. However, the computational expense of performing numerical simulations hinders their applicability to tasks that require real-time solutions or ensembles of solutions for different earthquake sources. To enable rapid physics-based solutions, we present a reduced-order modeling (ROM) approach based on interpolated proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) to predict peak ground velocities (PGVs).

arxiv-2304-12305.title: Downscaling Epidemiological Time Series Data for Improving Forecasting Accuracy: An Algorithmic Approach
arxiv-2304-12305.creator: Mahadee Al Mobin, Md. Kamrujjaman
arxiv-2304-12305.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mahadee Al Mobin, Md. Kamrujjaman. Data scarcity and discontinuity are common occurrences in the healthcare and epidemiological dataset and often need help in forming an educative decision and forecasting the upcoming scenario. Often, these data are stored as monthly/yearly aggregate where the prevalent forecasting tools like Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA), and TBATS often fail to provide satisfactory results. Artificial data synthesis methods have been proven to be a powerful tool for tackling these challenges.

arxiv-2306-15027.title: Laws of the iterated and single logarithm for sums of independent indicators, with applications to the Ginibre point process and Karlin’s occupancy scheme
arxiv-2306-15027.creator: Dariusz Buraczewski Alexander Iksanov, Valeriya Kotelnikova
arxiv-2306-15027.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dariusz Buraczewski Alexander Iksanov, Valeriya Kotelnikova. We prove a law of the iterated logarithm (LIL) for an infinite sum of independent indicators parameterized by t t and monotone in t t as t → ∞ t\to\infty . It is shown that if the expectation b b and the variance a a of the sum are comparable, then the normalization in the LIL includes the iterated logarithm of a a .

arxiv-2402-07935.title: On the Frobenius fields of abelian varieties over number fields
arxiv-2402-07935.creator: Ashay A. Burungale, Haruzo Hida, Shilin Lai
arxiv-2402-07935.description: Abstract . Let A A be a non-CM simple abelian variety over a number field K K . For a place v v of K K such that A A has good reduction at v v , let F ⁡ ( A , v ) F(A,v) denote the Frobenius field generated by the corresponding Frobenius eigenvalues.

arxiv-2402-12292.title: Regularization by denoising: Bayesian model and Langevin-within-split Gibbs sampling
arxiv-2402-12292.creator: Elhadji C. Faye, Mame Diarra Fall, Nicolas Dobigeon
arxiv-2402-12292.description: Abstract This paper introduces a Bayesian framework for image inversion by deriving a probabilistic counterpart to the regularization-by-denoising (RED) paradigm. It additionally implements a Monte Carlo algorithm specifically tailored for sampling from the resulting posterior distribution, based on an asymptotically exact data augmentation (AXDA).

arxiv-2406-08321.title: Deep learning from strongly mixing observations: Sparse-penalized regularization and minimax optimality
arxiv-2406-08321.description: Abstract William Kengne and Modou Wade Institut Camille Jordan, Université Jean Monnet, 23 Rue Dr Paul Michelon 42023 Saint-Étienne Cedex 2, France THEMA, CY Cergy Paris Université, 33 Boulevard du Port, 95011 Cergy-Pontoise Cedex, France E-mail: william.kengne@univ-st-etienne.fr ; modou.wade@cyu.fr Abstract : The explicit regularization and optimality of deep neural networks estimators from independent data have made considerable progress recently.

arxiv-2508-21129.title: Anyon polarons as a window into the competing phases of the Kitaev-Gamma-Gamma’ model
arxiv-2508-21129.creator: Chuan Chen, Inti Sodemann Villadiego
arxiv-2508-21129.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chuan Chen, Inti Sodemann Villadiego. We investigate the dispersions of anyon quasi-particles in the Kitaev honeycomb spin-liquid perturbed by Γ \Gamma and Γ ′ \Gamma^{\prime} couplings in order to understand phase transitions into competing states through anyon gap-closing instabilities.

arxiv-2509-17792.title: Degradation-Aware All-in-One Image Restoration via Latent Prior Encoding
arxiv-2509-17792.creator: S. M. A. Sharif, Abdur Rehman, Fayaz Ali Dharejo, Radu Timofte, Rizwan Ali Naqvi
arxiv-2509-17792.description: Abstract Real-world images often suffer from spatially diverse degradations such as haze, rain, snow, and low-light, significantly impacting visual quality and downstream vision tasks. Existing all-in-one restoration (AIR) approaches either depend on external text prompts or embed hand-crafted architectural priors (e.g., frequency heuristics); both impose discrete, brittle assumptions that weaken generalization to unseen or mixed degradations.

pmc-10542766.title: IGF1R-phosphorylated PYCR1 facilitates ELK4 transcriptional activity and sustains tumor growth under hypoxia

pmc-10542766.description: The proline synthesis is importantly involved in tumor growth under hypoxia, while the underlying mechanism remains to be further investigated. pmc-10572497.title: Enhanced Photovoltaic Properties of Y6 Derivatives with Asymmetric Terminal Groups: A Theoretical Insight

pmc-10572497.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Y6 derivatives with asymmetric terminal groups have attracted considerable attention in recent years. However, the effects of the asymmetric modification of terminal groups on the photovoltaic performance of Y6 derivatives are not well understood yet. Therefore, we designed a series of Y6-based acceptors with asymmetric terminal groups by endowing them with various electron-withdrawing abilities and different conjugated rings to conduct systematic research.

pmc-10605911.title: Behavioral Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation in Disorders of Consciousness: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-10605911.creator: Zihan Yang, Tian Yue, Volker R Zschorlich, Dai Li, Duanwei Wang, Fengxue Qi, Sergio Bagnato, Giuseppe Lanza, Rossella Breveglieri
pmc-10605911.description: Traumatic brain injury, cardiac arrest, intracerebral hemorrhage, and ischemic stroke may cause disorders of consciousness (DoC). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has been used to promote the recovery of disorders of consciousness (DoC) patients. In this meta-analysis, we examined whether rTMS can relieve DoC patient symptoms.

The article aims to provide a comparison of three RL algorithms—DQN as the benchmark, SARSA as a same-family algorithm, and A2C as a different-structure one—to address the problem of a UAV navigating from departure point A to endpoint B while avoiding obstacles and, simultaneously, using the least possible time and flying the shortest

pmc-10772657.description: BackgroundSpinal stenosis treatment includes laminectomies with or without fusion or with interspinous distraction with or without fixation. Lack of published data on interspinous fixation devices (IFD) at L5–S1 is less considered as an option due to the smaller anatomical S1 spinous process and the higher stresses from the immobile sacrum.

Conventional flotation operations consume a large amount of reagents and exhibit poor flotation indicators.

pmc-11570515.creator: Shihyun Kim, Suyeon Park, Yong-Jae Kim, Jeongeun Hyun, Jongho Choi
pmc-11570515.description: In epithelial cells, Scribble forms cell-cell junctions and contributes to cell morphology and homeostasis by regulating apical-basolateral polarity in mammals and functions as a tumor suppressor in many carcinomas. The initial diagnosis of oral squamous cell carcinoma is important, and its prognosis is poor when accompanied by metastasis.

pmc-11597721.title: What Is the Best Method for Diagnosing Osteosarcopenic Adiposity in Women After Long-Term Bariatric Surgery? A Comparison and Validation of Different Criteria

Methods: Surgery. This is a cross-sectional study with women ≥2 years post-RYGB. OSAd was diagnosed using three criteria: Kelly for OSAd; ESPEN/EASO and SDOC for SO, associated with WHO osteopenia, respectively.

pmc-12367815.title: Effects of psychological therapies in people with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-12367815.creator: Jillian Scandiffio, Laura Kathleen Langer, Vjura Senthilnathan, Gregory Feng, Ashvene Sureshkumar, Michelle Bromberg, Jessica Babineau, Sarah J Donkers, Katherine B Knox, Tania Bruno, Lisa A S Walker, Mark Theodore Bayley, Robert Simpson
pmc-12367815.description: BackgroundPeople with MS (PwMS) often experience high levels of emotional distress. Interventions to improve emotional wellbeing in PwMS are needed; however, the effectiveness of diverse psychological therapies in PwMS on cumulative outcomes is not well understood. This systematic review and network meta-analysis (NMA) aims to evaluate the effectiveness of psychological therapies in PwMS.

pmc-12681360.title: Prevalence of Periodontal Disease in South Pacific Island Countries: A Systematic Review

The objective of this systematic review was to evaluate the prevalence of periodontal disease in South Pacific Island countries. A literature search was conducted using Scopus, Medline (via PubMed and Ovid), databases, and Google Scholar. The inclusion criteria for the review were the studies that reported on periodontal disease in the 1- to 85-year age group, excluding data from Australia, New Zealand, and protectorates of the United States and France.

Deucravacitinib, a novel oral highly selective tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) inhibitor, has shown promise in treating various immune-mediated diseases. This study aimed to explore the therapeutic effects and underlying mechanisms of deucravacitinib in RA.
